descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Condition
The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 20.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
